# Contributing to sortrss

We welcome contributions! Please follow these steps to ensure a smooth process.

## CLA (Contributor License Agreement)

By contributing to this project, you agree to the terms of our [Contributor License Agreement](../CLA.md). **All contributors must sign the CLA before their pull requests can be merged.**

### How to sign

1. Submit your pull request as usual.
2. A CLA Assistant bot will automatically check if you've signed.
3. If you haven't signed, the bot will leave a comment. **Simply reply to that comment with the exact phrase:**
   > `I have read the CLA Document and I hereby sign the CLA`
4. The bot will record your signature and update the PR status.

### What if the CLA changes?

If the CLA is updated, you may be asked to sign again. The bot will detect the change and guide you through the re-signing process.

### Manual signing (optional)

If you prefer not to use the automated bot, you can manually download, sign, and email the CLA to `lumklar@outlook.com`. Please note that this will delay the review process.

## Code of Conduct

We adhere to the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/). Please be respectful and inclusive.

## Pull Request Checklist

- [ ] Signed CLA (automatically checked)
- [ ] Code compiles and passes tests
- [ ] Clear description of changes
- [ ] Follow existing coding style

## Questions?

Open an issue or contact the maintainer at `lumklar@outlook.com`.
